other.tags: Lo-fi hip hop instrumental. A dusty, sampled drum break features a muffled kick and a crisp, slightly off-grid snare with a prominent hi-hat shuffle. A melodic, electric piano progression uses jazz-influenced seventh chords with a soft tremolo effect. A deep, rounded sine-wave synth bass follows the root notes of the piano with a slight portamento between transitions. Atmospheric vinyl crackle and a low-pass filtered ambient pad persist throughout the arrangement. A recurring three-note glockenspiel motif appears every four bars. The tempo is 88 BPM in the key of C Major.

drums.tags: Lo-fi hip hop instrumental. The track features a dusty, sampled drum break with a prominent, slightly muffled kick and a crisp snare on beats 2 and 4. A repetitive, four-bar electric piano progression uses jazz-influenced seventh chords with a warm, saturated tone and noticeable wow and flutter. A melodic, syncopated electric bassline follows the chord changes with a rounded, sub-heavy timbre. Atmospheric vinyl crackle and a low-pass filter on the master bus create a vintage aesthetic. The tempo is 88 BPM in the key of C minor. A subtle, high-pitched sine wave synth lead enters periodically with a portamento effect.

vocals.tags: Electro-house with heavy funk and disco influences. A prominent, syncopated slap bass line drives the groove, characterized by percussive pops and slides. The drum machine features a crisp, high-tuned snare and a tight, dry kick. A recurring vocal chop sample, processed with a high-pass filter and rhythmic gating, repeats a short phrase. Bright, staccato synth stabs with a short decay provide harmonic accents on the off-beats. A resonant, sweeping low-pass filter effect is applied to the master bus during transitions. The track is in the key of G minor at 124 BPM.
